SFFI WEBSITE

REBUILD

Redesign an existing website that was created on WIX. Fix the website bugs, glitches and overall errors to being the site to a more usable and pleasant user experience. Set the site up in a simplistic four page boilerplate site structure to allow the user to navigate Safety First Firearms Instruction (SFFI) seamlessly.

UI UX WEB WIX REDESIGN

Similar Projects

Time to Reload

The Safety First Firearms Instruction (SFFI) website redesign project aimed to enhance the user experience and overall functionality of the site.

  • Enhanced Navigation
  • Improved Functionality
  • Content Hierarchy
  • Aspect Ratio Responsiveness
  • Modern Design Elements

Take Aim!

The redesign process involved several key steps to ensure that the new website met the needs of both the client and the users.

The original site had several issues that needed to be addressed to provide a more seamless and engaging experience for visitors.

  • The approach to fixing this site was simple but incorporated modern web design strategies.
  • Dave Vergilis, Owner / Instructor at SFFI, wanted his site to be his main hub of info about his practice.
  • Nothing fancy with SEO enhancements or eye-catching lottie animations but a simple site to house his info.
  • Requested that we make the edits to his site in WIX CMS.

Project Conclusion

It wasn't the most prudent way of going about redesigning a site, but I wanted to help Dave and respect his wishes.

  • Complete with Simple Navigation
  • Excellent Functionality
  • Content Hierarchy
  • Aspect Ratio Responsiveness
